Data from Tallgrass v0.78.21

Guides / Friends & trading / Wonder Trade

Wonder Trade

Send a Pokémon, get a surprise from another real trainer.

  • Opens with your 2nd badge. 5 Wonder Trades a UTC day, +1 per Gym badge (7 when it opens, 13 with all 8 badges). The panel shows how many are left today.
  • Always with real players: offline or with nobody waiting, no trade happens and your Pokémon stays.
  • Any Pokémon can go except your favourites, your party, the Day Care, one on the trade table, Mega Stone holders, fused or unrevealed Pokémon. If it's your only one of its species (or a special), the game asks first.
  • A Pokémon you got from a trade can go again 30 days after it arrived.
  • About 1 in 10 arrive Lucky (IVs 28–31). Held items and Mega Stones stay with you.
